confidence_notes: Holistic July estimate based on general knowledge, with no live listings used. Restaurant anchors are more certain than lodging, which can vary considerably during Montreal's summer festival season. Cocktail and wine estimates are inferred from their usual relationship to local beer prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Toronto provides a basis for urban restaurant and bar prices; Montreal's summer tourism demand raises lodging costs, while prices generally remain below those in major US destinations.
